── Deep Analysis ─════════════════════════════════════════
The open short is correctly sided — BTC has closed below EMA300 for 336 consecutive minutes with all four linreg slopes negative, 15m BTC regime SHORT_BIAS, and every 1m close for the last 40 bars under 68512. The book is not the problem tonight; the entries we closed are.

24h loser audit (8 losers, 6 of 8 never reached +0.40% MFE): four were counter-trend LONGs in a down tape — BTC LONG at meta_rsi 88.0 (16894, hard_max_loss, -4.11%, winning side = SHORT), INJ LONG at 55.5 via btc-pump-rider+ (16899, -5.84%, mfe only +0.049, winning side = SHORT/no-trade), JUP LONG at 35.3 (16901, -4.72%, never a tick positive, winning side = SHORT), IOTA LONG at 37.5 with its own metadata reading coin_regime SHORT_BIAS + btc_regime BEAR_TREND (16897, -2.41% in 120s, winning side = SHORT). One was the mirror failure: MNT SHORT at meta_rsi 74.0 (16890, -5.31%, mfe -0.05, winning side = LONG — overbought strength kept going). The remaining three were BTC shorts that stopped out near breakeven.

The fix is not an RSI band: 24h winners averaged meta_rsi 31.4 but losers spanned 21–88, so RSI at entry does not separate them. What separates them is momentum-at-entry — 8/8 winners armed (mfe ≥0.67) and moved immediately; 6/8 losers never went positive. We lose when we open before the move has started, in either direction. That is the same fact the chop-bleed KPI measures from the other side.

7d side split: SHORT 55T 52.7% WR (-$0.63) vs LONG 39T 38.5% WR (-$1.25) — below-EMA300 tape favors shorts. The purest cell is counter-trend LONG under BEAR_TREND (7d 4T 0W), but n=4 alone is a watch item, not an action; the 30d version (83T 38W -$1.72) is what gives it weight.

Dead-signal checks run before any flag: pump-chain+ shows 6T 0W -$0.54 in the watchdog window but 0 trades in 7d and PUMP_CHAIN_V4_ENABLED=False (killed 2026-09-22) — stale window, already killed, NO action. hh-hl+ (enabled, 1T), hl_copy_trader (2T), warrior-sr-confirm+ (4T), bb-squeeze+ (5T), pump-chain-/v6- (2T) are live but n≤5 — watch only. Flip rate normal (aggregate 20 / BTC 25 flips per 24h, n=96; baseline p50 19, p95 26), so no direction-flavored steer below leans on regime stability — every steer is keyed to a re-testable condition.

── Recommendations ──════════════════════════════════════════════
1. HOLD BTC SHORT 16902 with the stated exit condition (1m close above EMA300 68512 held 15-30m). SL 68551 already caps that test; R:R to TP is 1:8.2. No re-plate needed.
2. Brain-auditor gets an ENTRY-QUALITY pass: chop-bleed ≥92% on every window + 7d LONG arm 43.6% (<50 tripwire fired) + the counter-trend-LONG/BEAR_TREND source disagreement. Entry gates, not exit tweaks.
3. No new manual entries while 7d bleed sits at 93.5% — the never-armed cohort (atr_sl_hit + hard_max_loss = -$3.25 of -$4.43 gross, 0% WR) is charging a tax on every fresh position.
═════════════════════════════════════════════════════
